subject: Sponsorship: Pioneer Cloud Summit — custom package & speaking slot
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena@pioneerevents.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@pioneerevents.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sponsorship opportunity — Pioneer Cloud Summit (custom package & speaking slot)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking my call earlier. Attaching the master sponsorship deck and the latest expo floorplan for context (PCS-Sponsorship-Master-Deck.pdf, Expo_Floorplan_v3.png). Pioneer Cloud Summit (Nov 2027, Moscone West) is finalizing premium partners and we think Redwood Inference would be a great fit.

Quick summary of what we can offer as a base package:
- Platinum sponsor tier: 10x10 premium booth (backwall), 30-min breakout session in Track B, logo on website and main stage slides, 3 VIP passes.
- Additional add-ons: lanyard branding, dedicated workshop room, sponsored attendee reception table.
- Standard price: $85,000 (includes booth, session, website placement).

You mentioned interest in a hands-on workshop + stronger brand placement. We can do a custom package that includes a 45-minute workshop in the workshop room (+$12k), priority scheduling for a demo on the expo stage (+$5k), and lanyard branding (+$10k) pending availability. Important timing note: lanyard/artwork deadline is Dec 15.

If you'd like to move forward I can send a DocuSign with the custom package and the required exhibitor rules & insurance rider. What are your must-haves so I can lock in pricing?

Best,
Elena Garcia
Sponsorship Director
Pioneer Events

Attachment: PCS-Sponsorship-Master-Deck.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Expo_Floorplan_v3.png (image)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@pioneerevents.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship opportunity — Pioneer Cloud Summit (custom package & speaking slot)

Hi Elena,

Thanks — deck and floorplan look good. High level: we're interested but need a few changes before I can sign. Our core asks:

1) Logo placement: premium website + main-stage slide confirmed. We also want lanyard logo placement included in the package fee (we're a returning sponsor in strategy — would prefer not to add another 10k).
2) Session: swap the 30-min breakout for a 45-minute workshop (hands-on + live demo) in the workshop room; we need a slot with consistent AV (projector + HDMI + mic) and a table for 6 laptops.
3) Lead retrieval: CSV export of consenting leads within 24 hours of event (no additional charge).
4) Payment terms: Net30 is fine but request invoice split (50% deposit to confirm, remainder 30 days post-event) and a clause that guarantees workshop room size (min 40 pax) or a pro-rated credit if reduced.

I'm looping Monica (CS) to confirm lead/data handling and Lauren (Field Marketing) to coordinate creative. Attaching our brand guidelines and sponsor requirements so the design team can check logo/artwork rules.

If you can accommodate lanyard placement as part of the custom package and confirm the 45-min workshop + lead retrieval, we'll proceed to sign. Also need the DocuSign link and the contract redline window (we like a 3-business-day turnaround).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Redwood_sponsor_requirements.docx (docx)
Related: HubSpot deal RDW-PCS-2026-029
From: Elena Garcia <elena@pioneerevents.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship opportunity — Pioneer Cloud Summit (custom package & speaking slot)

Hi Rishi — great to see the quick internal loop. I spoke with ops and the answers are below. We want to make this work and have a couple compromise points.

- Lanyard: we can include lanyard branding in a custom platinum bundle but we need signed confirmation by Nov 30 and an incremental artwork fee of $4,500 to cover manufacturing lead time. If signed before Nov 18 we can waive the artwork fee.

- Workshop: we can allocate a 40-minute workshop slot in the workshop room with guaranteed AV (projector, HDMI, wired lav). We can also provide a 6-seat demo table. A full 45-minute room is tight in the schedule but we can split 40/5 Q&A — would that work?

- Lead retrieval: we’ll deliver a CSV of opted-in leads within 24 hours. Pioneer collects opt-in during registration; you can request additional lead-scopes but they may be limited.

- Payment: standard is 50% deposit on signature, remainder 30 days before the event. For your timeline we can do 50% deposit now, remainder Net30 after event (we'll allow that for confirmed partners).

- Workshop room capacity: we guarantee a room with min 35 seats. If final attendance is under 35 and we move to a smaller room due to scheduling, we offer a 10% credit to sponsorship fees (not including add-on artwork fees).

I've attached an updated quote in the DocuSign packet. Proposed price with the compromises: $85,000 base + Workshop add-on $12,000 (we'll do 40m) + Lanyard $10,000 (artwork fee waived if signed by Nov 18) + Priority demo slot on expo stage $5,000 = $112,000.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/PCS-Agreement/rdw-pcs-2026-029

If you confirm by EOD Nov 18 we'll lock in the lanyard without the artwork fee and schedule your workshop for the afternoon workshop block.

Best,
Elena Garcia
Sponsorship Director
Pioneer Events
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pioneer Cloud Summit — logistics & next steps (internal follow-up)

Folks — forwarding the latest from Elena. Summary and to-dos below so we can move fast if we decide to sign.

Summary of agreed points (tentative):
- Package: Platinum + workshop + lanyard + priority demo. Total quoted: $112,000 (DocuSign link above).
- Workshop: 40 minutes (35+ seat guarantee), AV: projector+HDMI+wired lav, 6-seat demo table. Schedule: afternoon workshop block (exact time pending).
- Lanyard: included if we sign by Nov 18; artwork fee waived if on that timeline. Artwork deadline: Dec 15.
- Lead retrieval: opted-in lead CSV within 24 hours of event.
- Payment: 50% deposit to confirm, remaining Net30 after event (Pioneer made an exception).
- Credits: if room capacity reduced <35 we get 10% credit to sponsorship fee.

Immediate action items:
- Monica: please review the data processing addendum and confirm we’re comfortable with opt-in lead CSV format and retention policy. Ask legal if we need a separate DPA for Pioneer.
- Lauren: confirm whether our creative team can deliver lanyard artwork by Dec 10 (buffer) and confirm the size/bleed specs from Elena. Also coordinate speaker bio + two slides.
- Ops (me): I'll review the DocuSign packet and request a 3-business-day redline window. I also want to confirm AV rider: will request wired lav + HDMI + on-site tech for first 30 minutes of the session.

Potential risks to flag: travel budget for workshop lead presenter (need $1,200 stipend), demonstration hardware (we'll bring 6 laptops + one demo GPU unit), and whether the demo table power is guaranteed.

I think this is a good visibility play for us — workshop + lanyards puts our logo in front of attendees and gives the team hands-on demos. If you both sign off I'll send Elena a confirmation and ask for the DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
